name: Intra Balance Movement 6
definition: Provides additional details of the intra-balance movements data.

BalanceFrom.name: Balance From
BalanceFrom.definition: Balance from which the amount of money is moved.

BalanceTo.name: Balance To
BalanceTo.definition: Balance to which the amount of money is moved.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

SettledAmount.name: Settled Amount
SettledAmount.definition: Amount of money effectively settled and which will be credited to/debited from the account owner's cash account. It may differ from the instructed settlement amount based on market tolerance level.

RemainingSettlementAmount.name: Remaining Settlement Amount
RemainingSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money remaining to be settled.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the amount of money is intended to be moved.

EffectiveSettlementDate.name: Effective Settlement Date
EffectiveSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the amount of money is moved.

StatusDate.name: Status Date
StatusDate.definition: Date and time at which the status was assigned.

CashSubBalanceIdentification.name: Cash Sub Balance Identification
CashSubBalanceIdentification.definition: Number identifying a lot constituting the sub-balance.

Linkages.name: Linkages
Linkages.definition: Link to another transaction that must be processed after, before or at the same time.

Priority.name: Priority
Priority.definition: Specifies whether the transaction is to be executed with a high priority.

MessageOriginator.name: Message Originator
MessageOriginator.definition: Party that originated the message, if other than the sender.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails.name: Instruction Processing Additional Details
InstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails.definition: Provides additional settlement processing information which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
